query:
SELECT id, title, status, quantity, remainingQuantity, sellerId, sellerType
FROM marketplaceListings
WHERE status = 'active' AND (quantity <= 0 OR remainingQuantity <= 0)
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 20;
